Constraints
* Please change "0 <" to "2 <=" (and optionally, use "≤" instead of "<=").

Thanks.

Try putting this in the statement:
```
    8----------7
   /|         /|
  / |        / |
 /  |       /  |
4---+------3   |
|   5------|---6
|  /       |  /
| /        | /
|/         |/
1----------2
```


Also, remember to format numbers as constants {{}}.

Input
- It would probably be best to provide a variable [[n]] to be consistent with the statement. 
- "(each between 1 and 8 each)" can be replaced with "(each between {{1}} and {{8}} inclusive)"

Output
- "The length of the shortest possible path for the tour" sounds a bit better to me

Constraints
- 500 seems a bit excessive

Cases
 - I can understand why most of the current case pairs have the same output, but it would be best to drown that out with many more case pairs that have differing outputs.

I haven't attempted the puzzle yet, these are just my preliminary thoughts, but it seems like it will be fun.

I've made the suggested changes. Thanks for the ASCII version of the cube!
I've reduced the maximum numbers of corners from 500 to 200 now.

The test cases are not finished yet. There will be more test cases, of course. It is still WIP.
